### The Vision of Isaiah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/vision-isaiah
Passage: Isaiah 1:1
Points:
- Material prosperity often leads God's people to forget their Provider and credit their own strength.
- Judah drifted into idolatry, social injustice, and ungodly alliances instead of relying on the Lord.
- God sent the prophet Isaiah to confront the nation's spiritual rebellion and issue a call to repentance.
- Believers must actively cultivate gratitude so that blessings do not supplant the Lord in their hearts.

### Bible Pathways 08/01/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-08-or-01-or-2002-1147162.html
Passage: Isaiah 1:2-4
Points:
- The Lord expresses deep parental sorrow over the rebellion and corruption of His covenant people.
- Even basic domestic animals know their masters, yet Israel failed to recognize and honor God.
- Believing parents who face the grief of wayward children can relate to God's heartbreak over the lost.
- God graciously reaches out to the wayward through His Word, offering forgiveness and restoration to those who repent.
